messages:
marta_finance: EmberHealth (acct EH-331) invoice 7012 charge ch_A1b2C3 failed with `insufficient_funds`. Dropping here to coordinate retries and alternatives.

derrick_ops: How many retries are scheduled? @stripe-bot

stripe-bot: Charge `ch_A1b2C3` currently has 1 scheduled retry remaining.

olivia_cs: Just spoke to Jorge at EmberHealth. They asked us not to retry the card  they're switching banks and prefer ACH. Asked for microdeposit steps and ETA.

cam_payments: Pause retries then. I'll cancel scheduled attempts and tag account `manual_collections`. Offer wire/ACH as alternatives. We can cover one incoming bank fee up to $25 as a courtesy.

marta_finance: Approved $25 courtesy. No service suspension for a single invoice. Provide ACH microdeposit steps (2-3 business days) and wire instructions as a faster option.

olivia_cs: Sending ACH template now. I'll include: if they want same-day, send wire and attach receipt; we'll reconcile immediately. Also asking if they want a short extension on renewal while bank switches.

nina_revops: Tag applied `no_auto_retry:10d` on acct EH-331. Created FIN-6209 to track reconciliation and webhook suppression. Adding internal note to billing playbook for `insufficient_funds` flows.

derrick_ops: Scheduled retries canceled for ch_A1b2C3. OPS will monitor incoming payments and reconcile to FIN-6209.

olivia_cs: Email excerpt sent to Jorge:
"Hi Jorge  we've paused further card attempts. To pay by ACH please follow microdeposit verification (2-3 business days). If you prefer a same-day option, wire and attach the receipt here and we'll post immediately. We will cover up to $25 of incoming bank fees for this payment.

ACH details:
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Account: 7744110022
Routing (ABA): 026009593
Reference: INV-7012
"

marta_finance: Thanks. If they request fee coverage > $25 escalate to finance-leads. Closing for now; reopen on payment receipt or escalation.
